h800.label: H800 80GB (AutoDL)
h800.notes: New AutoDL instance (2026-10-01) at connect.westb.seetacloud.com:21310; login block 'H800' in login_ref; WSL ssh alias h800 (key-based). No GitHub credentials on the host: code is copied with rsync (tracked files + .git; rsync with --no-o --no-g or chown root afterwards, else git reports dubious ownership) and results come back with remote.sh fetch. venv <root>/.venv (torch 2.8.0+cu128, Triton 3.4.0), HF_HOME=/root/autodl-tmp/hf_home via the untracked .tpds_env. No-GPU mode caps memory at 2 GB and 0.5 CPU: the runtime-chunk reference build (selective_scan_chunk_cuda, sm_90) is OOM-killed there, so tpds_lane_r3_e13.sh builds it at the start of the GPU session.
